coordinate_frames.native_xy: KiCad X right, Y down, board front viewed above. All *_native_mm and *_native_xy_mm retain native coordinates.
coordinate_frames.enclosure_cartesian: Optional x=X-20, y=39-Y, z positive from front board surface; board top z=0, bottom z=-thickness. No translation applied to native data.
coordinate_frames.fp_local_transform: X=px+lx*cos(a)+ly*sin(a); Y=py-lx*sin(a)+ly*cos(a). Parsed local coords already include native side mirroring when footprint on B.Cu; verify using extracted native pad positions.
coordinate_frames.z: Front surface datum 0; bottom -0.8. Individual STEP model coordinate axes/transforms are recorded separately; model bounds are not measured physical tolerance.
